rules.sentence: The diagnosis is typically made by excluding known thrombocytopenia causes.

The American Society of Hematology (ASH) defines ITP as a generalized purpuric rash accompanied by a platelet count less than 100,000/μL and normal white blood cell (WBC) count and hemoglobin level.[1]
Leukocyte count and hemoglobin abnormalities are not characteristic of ITP and should prompt additional diagnostic testing when detected.
